en: Arūpāvacaraduka (The Dyad on the Formless Realm)

Dependent on a state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere, there arises a state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere, there arises a state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is both of the fine-material sphere and of the immaterial sphere, there arises a state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, two ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
